A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Hi, I’m Mike.

I’m a software engineer. I write about what I’m learning and building with Java, Spring, databases, distributed systems, and AI agents.

About this blog

Some ideas only become clear when I write them down. This blog is a place to connect scattered observations and leave a trail for the next time I face the same problem.

Expect source code walkthroughs, notes on system design, and observations from trying new tools.
